"""Verify bulk_create(update_conflicts=True) emits db_column names in ON CONFLICT."""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=[],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)
django.setup()

from django.db import connection, models
from django.test.utils import CaptureQueriesContext


class ActivityBlackListed(models.Model):
    class Meta:
        db_table = "Activity_BlackListed"
        app_label = "bulk"

    blacklistid = models.IntegerField(primary_key=True, db_column="BlacklistID")
    sectorid = models.IntegerField(null=True, blank=True, db_column="SectorID")


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(ActivityBlackListed)

ActivityBlackListed.objects.bulk_create(
    [ActivityBlackListed(blacklistid=1, sectorid=10)]
)

objs = [
    ActivityBlackListed(blacklistid=1, sectorid=999),
    ActivityBlackListed(blacklistid=2, sectorid=20),
]
with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx:
    ActivityBlackListed.objects.bulk_create(
        objs,
        update_conflicts=True,
        update_fields=["sectorid"],
        unique_fields=["blacklistid"],
    )
sql = ctx.captured_queries[-1]["sql"]
print("SQL:", sql)
assert '"BlacklistID"' in sql, "unique_fields must use db_column"
assert '"SectorID" = EXCLUDED."SectorID"' in sql, "update_fields must use db_column"
assert '"blacklistid"' not in sql and '"sectorid"' not in sql, "no field-name leakage"
rows = list(ActivityBlackListed.objects.values("blacklistid", "sectorid"))
print("ROWS:", rows)
assert rows == [
    {"blacklistid": 1, "sectorid": 999},
    {"blacklistid": 2, "sectorid": 20},
], rows
print("OK: ON CONFLICT uses db_column; upsert updated the existing row")
